name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support of Rs.6,000 per year to small and marginal farmer families.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with landholding less than 2 hectares.
benefits: Quarterly direct cash transfer of Rs.2000 to farmer's bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme to protect farmers against crop failure.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops and enrolled in the scheme.
benefits: Compensation for crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil testing and nutrient recommendations to farmers.
eligibility: All farmers can apply for soil testing.
benefits: Better crop yields through recommended fertilizers and amendments.
